items.title: UK clothing sales slump as warm weather hits autumn demand
items.snippet: UK retail sales fell more sharply than expected in September as unseasonably warm weather dampened demand for autumn and winter clothing.

items.title: BRC demands budget tax cut as UK consumer confidence slumps
items.snippet: UK consumer confidence deteriorated further in October, with expectations for the state of the economy and personal finances both falling.

items.title: Six ways brands, factories can tackle climate-linked worker risk
items.snippet: Jeff Vockrodt of the FLA says the burden of climate change and the associated impact on factory workers should not fall on suppliers alone.

items.title: Very Group reports record FY26 despite ‘persistent weakness’ in fashion
items.snippet: The Very Group reported a record earnings performance in fiscal 2026 (FY26) despite "persistent weakness" in its fashion offering.

items.title: Gen Z shopping habits driving returns, spikes in demand
items.snippet: Younger consumers are dramatically reshaping shopping and returns behaviours, according to new research released by Locus Robotics.

items.title: Weak clothing dampens H1 sales at Sainsbury’s as it reports $219m loss
items.snippet: Sainsbury’s reported a statutory loss after tax of £164m ($219m) in H1 FY26/27, reflecting subdued performance in its Tu clothing business.

items.title: ABB adds closed-loop physical AI to fashion logistics automation
items.snippet: ABB Robotics has launched a vision-based AI solution aimed at automating and optimising fashion logistics processes.

items.title: Why Dryrobe turned down a ‘dream’ corporate offer
items.snippet: Dryrobe’s founder and owner Gideon Bright reveals he turned down a “corporate dream exit” to safeguard the brand’s values.

items.title: Traceability is becoming ‘core infrastructure’ Cascale report argues
items.snippet: In a new report, Cascale says traceability and standardised data are becoming essential for managing risks and understanding performance.

items.title: Cotton Brazil launches ‘Hanging by a Thread’ movement at ICA Istanbul
items.snippet: Cotton Brazil has launched the “Hanging by a Thread” movement at the ICA Trade Event Istanbul 2026, highlighting the impacts of microplastics
